integrity: An elementary proof is supplied in RESULT.md. The standalone exact-arithmetic verifier supplies finite corroboration only. No independent review or external validation has been performed.
limitations: The exact law is for positive-definite one-defect diagonal-plus-common-factor matrices, residual-diagonal randomized Cholesky, distinct pivots, and trace error. Greedy separation is a one-pivot scaling family; no implication for all PSD matrices, other norms, or rounding error. Historical priority remains subject to independent literature review.
title: Exact two-atom residual law and sharp pivoting reversal on common-factor matrices
